Jenna (Product): quick kickoff — we need a crisp decision for onboarding -> GA lifecycle: pin TTL default, deprecation notice length, and an extension path for customer requests. BigCart asked for 180 days which feels long. thoughts?
Marco (Eng): 180d is risky for compatibility and storage. longer pins block model upgrades and complicate cache evictions. recommend a sane default + extension process.
Alex (ML): for any longer-run pins we should require an acceptance benchmark (quality + regressions). otherwise we silently ship worse outputs. link to eval harness: https://redwood.internal/evals/onboard 
Priya (PM): BigCart is pushing hard because of regulatory approvals. they asked for predictability. propose default 90d pin + formal extension review for >90d.
Sam (Support): support needs a templated comms package and migration checklist. if we deprecate, customers want clear steps and a migration timeline. I can draft templates once policy decided. :+1:
Liam (SRE): operational note — longer pin TTL means more model variants in serving. we need quota/gc rules and a canary capacity plan to avoid slowdowns during cutovers.
Marco (Eng): agree with Priya + Alex. also require a canary window and automated rollback gate. minimal policy sketch:
```
pin_ttl_days: 90
deprecation_notice_days: 60
extension_process: "apply -> product review -> acceptance benchmark"
canary_window_hours: 72
rollback_on_regression: true
```
Alex (ML): benchmarks we should gate on (strings): ["semantic-quality (F1)", "generation-latency-95p", "per-token-cost delta"] — pass thresholds must be in the onboarding ticket.
Priya (PM): decision needed this sprint so sales can answer BigCart. quick poll: 90d default + extensions via review? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.
Jenna (Product): I'll lock policy if we get majority. also: define extension SLAs (how long review takes) and what counts as acceptable benchmark delta.
Sam (Support): I'll start a migration checklist draft and sample customer comms. will drop in #ops-templates.
Liam (SRE): ops-bot, create runbook PR for model pin lifecycle (canary, rollback, GC).
ops-bot: created runbook draft at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-pin-lifecycle PR #423
Marco (Eng): one more constraint — for 3rd-party pinned models we must expose a compatibility shim option. customers can opt into auto-adapt or stay pinned. fallback path must be documented.
Alex (ML): if extension requested, require a snapshot of the eval set and a short A/B with current & candidate model (10k samples) to sanity-check regressions.
Priya (PM): timeline: decide policy by Thu EOD -> doc + templates Fri -> BigCart response Mon. Jenna, can you own sign-off?
Jenna (Product): I will. action items:
- Jenna: final sign-off Thu EOD
- Marco: add compatibility shim plan + GC limits (due Wed)
- Alex: define acceptance benchmarks + eval checklist (due Wed)
- Sam: draft comms + migration checklist (due Fri)
- Liam: runbook PR review and canary capacity plan (due Fri)
- Priya: coordinate BigCart expectations and extension requests (ongoing)
Jenna (Product): ok — sounds good. tagging this thread as the single source for decisions. please keep comments short and actionable. :rocket:
